data.summary_en: ImageRSI is a verification-driven recursive self-improvement framework for complex text-to-image requests. With frozen generator, it combines in-task verification repair, cross-task experience library, offline-updated critic, and A/B paired validation to filter experience. On MindBench with Nano Banana Pro, authors achieve 52.6% CSA; on ImageReq-Bench, 65.66% CSA.
